mapper.sql: id, order_no, company_id, user_id, order_type, biz_type, biz_id, title, amount, discount, paid_amount, pay_method, pay_status, pay_time, pay_trade_no, expire_time, closed_time, refund_amount, invoice_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_billing_order ( order_no, company_id, user_id, order_type, biz_type, biz_id, title, amount, discount, paid_amount, pay_method, pay_status, expire_time, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{companyId}, #{userId}, #{orderType}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{title}, #{amount}, #{discount}, #{paidAmount}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{expireTime}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE opc_billing_order SET pay_status = 'PAID', pay_time = NOW(), pay_trade_no = #{payTradeNo}, paid_amount = amount WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND pay_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'PAID' THEN paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_amount, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS refunded_amount FROM opc_billing_order WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{period},'-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND create_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{period},'-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

SELECT pay_method AS channel, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM opc_billing_order WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND order_type = 'RECHARGE' AND pay_status = 'PAID' AND create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{period},'-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND create_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{period},'-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY pay_method
